name: Dub
description: A managed component for Dub.co link tracking and ecommerce events

fields.name: DUB_API_KEY
fields.label: Dub API Key
fields.description: Your Dub API key. You can find this in your Dub workspace settings

fields.name: DUB_WORKSPACE_ID
fields.label: Dub Workspace ID
fields.description: The ID of the Dub workspace you want to send events to

fields.name: DUB_API_HOST
fields.label: Dub API Host
fields.description: Override the host used for the click-tracking API call. Defaults to https://api.dub.co

fields.name: DUB_SHORT_DOMAIN
fields.label: Dub Short Domain
fields.description: Your Dub short link domain. Required to record clicks for visits that land directly on your site with a short link key in the URL (e.g. yoursite.com/?via=abc123) instead of via an actual short-domain redirect

fields.name: DUB_ATTRIBUTION_MODEL
fields.label: Dub Attribution Model
fields.description: 'last-click' (default) or 'first-click' — whether a later click on the same visitor can override an already-attributed one

fields.name: DUB_QUERY_PARAMS
fields.label: Dub Query Parameters
fields.description: Additional query parameters to check for a short link key, as a JSON array or comma-separated list (e.g. "via,ref"). 'via' is always included by default

access_client_kv.description: Dub uses cookies to track clicks and attribute conversions

server_network_requests.description: This permission is used to send tracking events to Dub's API, including recording clicks

provide_server_functionality.description: Allow Dub to provide custom server-side tracking logic
